To find the floor area of a room measuring 19.4 ft by 19.7 ft in square meters, we start by calculating the area in square feet:

\[
\text{Area in square feet} = 19.4 \, \text{ft} \times 19.7 \, \text{ft} = 382.18 \, \text{ft}^2
\]

Next, we convert the area from square feet to square meters using the conversion factor \(1 \, \text{ft} = 0.3048 \, \text{m}\). The conversion factor for square feet to square meters is:

\[
1 \, \text{ft}^2 = (0.3048 \, \text{m})^2 = 0.09290304 \, \text{m}^2
\]

Converting the area:

\[
\text{Area in square meters} = 382.18 \, \text{ft}^2 \times 0.09290304 \, \text{m}^2/\text{ft}^2 \approx 35.5056838272 \, \text{m}^2
\]

Rounding this result to two decimal places, we get:

\[
\text{Area in square meters} \approx 35.51 \, \text{m}^2
\]

Thus, the final answer is:

\[
\boxed{35.51}
\]

   \[

   13.6875 \, \text{lb} \times 0.45359237 \, \frac{\text{kg}}{\text{lb}} = 6.208545564375 \, \text{kg}
   \]

   \[
   6.208545564375 \approx 6.21 \, \text{kg}
   \]

Thus, the mass of the parcel is \(\boxed{6.21}\).
